historical.docs/SPEC.md: struck passages cite the files their decisions deleted (e.g. :805 on src/builder/lock.ts)
historical.docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md: shipped task rows cite what they retired; :186 annotates its own deletion date
historical.docs/RETROSPECTIVES.md: per-phase record of what was true at phase close
historical.docs/FUTURE_IDEAS.md: parked ideas cite sketches and drop-lists that predate the current tree
historical.docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md: findings as of an audit date, same shape as docs/audit/

runbooks.docs/DEPLOY.md: post-deploy smoke checks a person runs against the live domain; no npm script can wrap a probe of production
runbooks.docs/HOSTING_MIGRATION.md: one-time hosting migration performed by hand, verified against the new host before cutover
runbooks.docs/RUNNING.md: quick-start install on a fresh machine, and a dev login-code read a developer does at a terminal
